ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Students must register for the lecture and one lab. Broadcast majors will register for sections AB1 or AB2 and News-Editorial majors will register for sections AB3 or AB4. Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s).
